summary.value: The reviewers pointed out several weaknesses and shared common concerns, including (a) lack of discussion and comparison with relevant papers; (b) limited scope to the mathematical geometry domain instead of general spatial capability; (c) the mathematical reasoning required may limit evaluation of general geo-spatial capability as intended; (d) lack of in-depth analysis for the failure modes; (e) lack of recent models in the evaluation.
